mapper.select: SELECT bo.id, bo.order_no, bo.room_type_id, rt.type_name as roomTypeName, bo.room_price, bo.check_in_date , bo.check_out_date , bo.days, bo.guest_name , bo.guest_phone , bo.guest_id_card , bo.total_amount , bo.status, bo.payment_method, bo.payment_no, bo.create_time FROM booking_order bo LEFT JOIN room_type rt ON bo.room_type_id = rt.id WHERE bo.id = #{orderId}

SELECT bo.id, bo.order_no as orderNo, bo.user_id as userId, bo.room_type_id as roomTypeId, rt.type_name as roomTypeName, bo.check_in_date as checkInDate, bo.check_out_date as checkOutDate, bo.days, bo.guest_name as guestName, bo.guest_phone as guestPhone, bo.total_amount as totalAmount, bo.status, bo.create_time as createTime FROM booking_order bo LEFT JOIN room_type rt ON bo.room_type_id = rt.id
AND bo.order_no LIKE '%' || #{orderNo} || '%'
AND bo.guest_name LIKE '%' || #{guestName} || '%'
AND bo.guest_phone LIKE '%' || #{guestPhone} || '%'
AND bo.guest_id_card LIKE '%' || #{guestIdCard} || '%'
AND bo.status = #{status}
AND TRUNC(bo.check_in_date) = TRUNC(#{checkInDate,jdbcType=DATE})
ORDER BY bo.create_time DESC

SELECT bo.id, bo.order_no as orderNo, bo.user_id as userId, u.username as username, bo.room_type_id as roomTypeId, rt.type_name as roomTypeName, bo.room_price as roomPrice, bo.check_in_date as checkInDate, bo.check_out_date as checkOutDate, bo.days, bo.guest_name as guestName, bo.guest_phone as guestPhone, bo.guest_id_card as guestIdCard, bo.total_amount as totalAmount, bo.status, bo.payment_method as paymentMethod, bo.payment_time as paymentTime, bo.payment_no as paymentNo, bo.create_time as createTime FROM booking_order bo LEFT JOIN room_type rt ON bo.room_type_id = rt.id LEFT JOIN USERS u ON bo.user_id = u.id WHERE bo.id = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM booking_order WHERE room_type_id = #{roomTypeId} AND id != #{orderId} AND status IN (1, 2, 3) AND ( (TRUNC(check_in_date) <= TRUNC(#{checkOutDate, jdbcType=DATE}) AND TRUNC(check_out_date) > TRUNC(#{checkInDate, jdbcType=DATE})) OR (TRUNC(check_in_date) < TRUNC(#{checkOutDate, jdbcType=DATE}) AND TRUNC(check_out_date) >= TRUNC(#{checkOutDate, jdbcType=DATE})) OR (TRUNC(check_in_date) <= TRUNC(#{checkInDate, jdbcType=DATE}) AND TRUNC(check_out_date) >= TRUNC(#{checkOutDate, jdbcType=DATE})) )
mapper.update: UPDATE booking_order SET status = #{status}, cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, cancel_time = SYSDATE, update_time = SYSDATE WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE booking_order SET status = #{status}, update_time = SYSDATE WHERE id = #{id}
